newsitem.title: USA: Bemis says Paramount costs could cut Q2 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Bemis says Paramount costs could cut Q2 EPS.

text.p: Bemis Co Inc said its acquisition of Parmount Packaging, which reduced first-quarter earnings by about $0.05 per share, could reduce second-quarter earnings by as much as $0.03 per share.

It said the impact was primarily due to temporarily high manufacturing and overhead costs and some reorganization expenses. Bemis said the operations are expected to become profitable in the second half of the year.

Earlier Tuesday, Bemis posted first quarter earnings of $0.37 per share versus $0.41 per share a year ago. The 1996 quarter included a gain of $0.05 per share on the sale of a portion of the company's packaging machinery business in the first quarter of 1996.
Total sales rose to $475.4 million from $385.5 million. It said about nine percent of the sales gain came from existing operations, with the balance from acquisitions.
Paramount Packaging added about $34 million to net sales.

Bemis said the previously announced sale of the company's packaging machinery businesses is expected to close during the second quarter and result in a one-time gain. It expects the loss of operating income from these businesses during the balance of the year to reduce projected full-year 1997 earnings by as much as $0.05 per share.
Bemis said its strategy is to focus on key markets and customers in the flexible packaging side of the business.
